boundary.en: 12306, THE AIRLINE, THE BOOKING, AND SAME-DAY OFFICIAL NOTICES OVERRIDE THIS MAP. NO TIMETABLE, FARE, OR CONNECTION IS PROMISED.

generalizations: The diagram is an original LazyTravel departure checklist, not an official railway, airline, station, airport, road, or metro diagram
The three departure points are alternatives selected only by the live booking and never by assumed train class or direction
Arrows show planning order, not distance, walking routes, road geometry, travel time, or a guaranteed connection
Next overnight city is an itinerary unit and does not imply that any specific destination has a direct service from the drawn gate
Station circulation, terminal assignment, check-in, ticket checking, baggage, and assistance remain live operational checks
A changed booking, warning, disruption, or official instruction overrides the diagram

notes: The 1620 x 2280 source and 300 dpi B6 page preserve the three mutually exclusive departure lanes, readings, keep/cut boundary, and live-booking warning without collision or clipping.

At a 390 px viewport the map uses a 760 px independently scrollable stage with working zoom and reset controls; primary labels remain readable and the browser QA reports no overflow, request, or console failure.
